in_sanskrit.name: Babon
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mystic warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Babon एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Babhru', meaning dark-complexioned. In Hindu mythology, Babhru is a name given to Lord Shiva, symbolizing his dark, mystic form. Babon is a tribute to this powerful and enigmatic deity.
